title: Tomonori Taniguchi from AI Medical Engineering Team Selected as a Japanese Delegate to GYSS 2027
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: Tomonori Taniguchi from the AI Medical Engineering Team led by Team Director Ryuji Hamamoto was selected as a Japanese delegate to Global Young Scientists Summit (GYSS) 2027. GYSS is organized by the Singapore National Research Foundation, an agency within the Prime Minister’s Office of Singapore. The Summit brings together young scientists and researchers, including PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, from around the world. Invited speakers are internationally renowned scientific leaders, including recipients of the Nobel Prize, Fields Medal, Millennium Technology Prize, and Turing Award. GYSS 2027 will be held in Singapore from 4 to 8 January 2027. Nihonbashi 1-chome Mitsui Building, 15th floor, e-mail: aip-koho [at]riken.jp *Please replace "[at]" with "@".
